A LITTLE SURPRISE FOR MY FAVOURITE PERSON

I Love You, Junnu ❤️

To my husband, my best friend, and my favourite place to call home. Every day is more beautiful because I have you.

My favourite person, forever 💗

Junnu,
Nuvvu naa life lo undatam naaku chaala special. Nee smile naaku happiness, nee presence naaku comfort. Manam kalisi navvukune chinna chinna moments anni naaku precious. Life lo em jarigina, nee pakkana undi neetho kalisi anni face cheyyali anedhe naa korika.

I love you more than words can say. ❤️
Naa Junnu ki oka promise… 💞
I will keep choosing you, supporting you, and loving you—in ordinary days and in the hardest ones too.

Forever yours,
Your Wife ❤️
Made with all my love, just for you 🌷
Always us. Always love.
